quests.title: Secret Garden Discovery
objectives: Defeat Rival Blue on Route 22 immediately after returning Oak's Parcel.
Walk through the tree gap on the eastern edge of Route 1 directly below the Viridian City ledge.
CRITICAL: If Brock is defeated before battling Blue on Route 22, Blue vacates Route 22 and the Secret Garden is permanently lost for the entire save!

quests.title: Secret Garden Rockruff Nest
objectives: Inspect the center Pokémon nest in Secret Garden.
WARNING: Taking the egg reduces your Karma by 5, which hinders the +20 Karma threshold required for Mew on Mt. Moon Summit.

quests.title: Mushroom Gathering
objectives: Speak to the chef on the 2nd floor of Pewter Hotel.
Collect 3 Tiny Mushrooms from Viridian Forest.
Deliver the mushrooms to the chef for the Balm Mushroom reward.

quests.title: Lost Medicine
objectives: Speak to the Youngster on the 2nd floor of Pewter Hotel.
Search under the benches across Pewter City to find his dropped Revive.
Return the Revive to the Youngster. (Do NOT sell or toss it, or you will lose 5 Karma!).

quests.title: Bug Evolution
objectives: Speak to the Bug Catcher on the 2nd floor of Pewter Hotel.
Show him a fully-evolved Bug Pokémon (Butterfree or Beedrill, evolved at Lv. 10).
Receive the gift Pineco.

quests.title: I Choose You!
objectives: Talk to the Pikachu inside the Pewter City Poké Mart.
Find the official League Hat in the city and return it.

quests.title: Nectar Garden
objectives: Talk to the old man in the Pewter City flower garden.
Deliver pink flowers from Route 2 (Before Forest) for Oran Berry.
Deliver red flowers from Route 3 for Sitrus Berry.
Deliver blue flowers from Route 4 for Lum Berry.
Catch the visiting Oricorio Sensu Style to receive Berry Juice.

quests.title: Playing Cupid
objectives: Accept the love letter from the boy in the Cerulean City Hotel.
Defeat Pokémon Breeder Maude on the route south of Cerulean City (Route 5).
Deliver the love letter to Maude to receive 5 Love Balls.

quests.title: Johto Pokémon
objectives: Speak to the traveler inside the Cerulean Poké Mart.
Show him any Pokémon native to the Johto region (e.g. Sentret, Hoothoot, Pineco, Ledyba).

quests.title: Field Research (Part 1)
objectives: Speak to Professor Oak's aide inside Cerulean City Pokémon Center.
Fuse at least five Pokémon using DNA Splicers.
Meet the aide on Route 24 and catch an Abra to receive the Poké Radar.

quests.title: Nugget Bridge Rocket Recruitment
rewards: Access to Team Rocket Cerulean HQ
objectives: Defeat the 5 trainers on Nugget Bridge.
The Team Rocket Grunt at the end offers you to join Team Rocket.

RECOMMENDED DOUBLE-AGENT PATH: Agree to join (-5 Karma, but unlocks Rocket missions). By reporting the upcoming Rocket crimes to the Cerulean police officer, you will net +20 Karma total, earning far more Karma than refusing (+5) while securing Diancie!

quests.title: Creepy Crawlies
objectives: Enter the temporary Rocket HQ in Cerulean City disguised in your Rocket uniform.
Speak to the Team Rocket Captain and clear the bug infestation in the basement.

quests.title: No Fishing Zone
quests.missable_deadline: Before defeating Misty (Gym 2) for police report; Gym 8 for Rocket turn-in
rewards: ₽8,000 (Rocket turn-in) OR +10 Karma & Diancie Police Path (Officer Jenny report)
objectives: Accept mission from Rocket Captain to intimidate fishermen on Nugget Bridge.
UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: DO NOT intimidate the fishermen. Instead, immediately speak to the Police Officer in Cerulean City blocking the Route 5 entrance.
Report Team Rocket's harassment to the police BEFORE defeating Misty to earn +10 Karma and unlock the Police Pinkan Island heist!

quests.title: Disobedient Pokémon
rewards: ₽4,000 + Azurill/Zubat (Rocket) OR +10 Karma & Diancie Police Path (Officer Jenny report)
objectives: Accept mission to discipline a disobedient stolen Pokémon.
UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: Take the Pokémon directly to the Cerulean police officer to report Pokémon theft.
Earn +10 Karma and advance the Police Informant storyline towards Diancie.

quests.title: Gran Theft Pokémon!
objectives: Follow Team Rocket Executive Petrel to steal a rare Pokémon from a young trainer.
Advance the Team Rocket infiltrator storyline to Celadon City.

quests.title: Mythical Mew Encounter
objectives: Climb to Mt. Moon Summit.
Requires a Karma score of +20 or higher to trigger Mew's presence!
Achieved easily by following the Undercover Informant path (reporting 2 Rocket crimes = +20 Karma) and avoiding egg theft.

quests.title: The Lumberjack! (Shears Acquisition)
objectives: Enter Diglett's Cave from Route 11 / Vermilion City in Chapter 3.
Exit onto the isolated eastern portion of Route 2.
Enter the house surrounded by cuttable trees and accept the quest from the elderly man.
Go into the backyard and interact with every small tree to cut them all down.
Speak to the man to claim your Lemonade, +1 Karma, and the Shears!

quests.title: Building Materials
objectives: Speak to the construction foreman in Vermilion City.
Retrieve wooden planks from Viridian City and bricks from Pewter City.
Deliver the materials before beating the Elite Four to receive the Rocky Helmet.

quests.title: Supplying the New Grunts
objectives: Catch 4 Pokémon using Rocket Balls in the outskirts of Celadon City.

quests.title: Interception!
rewards: Choice of: TM13 Ice Beam, TM24 Thunderbolt, or TM35 Flamethrower
objectives: Intercept the genuine TM shipment to Celadon Department Store and deliver fake TMs.

quests.title: Pokémon Collector
rewards: Scraggy (Rocket) OR +10 Karma & Diancie Police Path (Officer Jenny report)
objectives: Meet the Pokémon collector on Route 22.
UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: Report the illegal trafficker to the Celadon police officer to gain +10 Karma.

quests.title: Pinkan Island Police Raid
objectives: Available if you reported Rocket crimes to the police during Cerulean or Celadon missions.
Join forces with Officer Jenny to raid Team Rocket's operation on Pinkan Island.
Rescue the island and encounter Mythical Diancie.
